# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

Project participants are expected to keep discussions respectful, constructive, and focused on the work.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful of different viewpoints and levels of experience.
- Give and receive constructive feedback in good faith.
- Keep issue and pull request discussions focused on the technical topic.
- Assume responsibility for mistakes and correct them promptly.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, threats, insults, or personal attacks.
- Sexualized language or imagery.
- Publishing private information without explicit permission.
- Sustained disruption of project discussions.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove comments, close issues, reject contributions, or block participants when behavior conflicts with this code of conduct. Reports should be sent to the project maintainers through an appropriate private channel when possible.
